mostWorthwhile.text: Making the supernova was most worthwhile: core collapse corrected my guess that Fire would trigger the explosion and clarified one possible fate of a massive star.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive inspections of the supernova and remnant felt somewhat repetitive, even though they advanced the story.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the remnant had two possible partners after several single-option transformations; heavy elements led to enriched dust.

arbitrary.text: Earth transforming the fusing core into heavy elements felt symbolic rather than physically clear, although the accompanying explanation clarified stellar fusion.

continue.text: Yes. The new stellar nursery suggests a compelling next chapter about how enriched material becomes rocky worlds, and the scientific qualifications made the myth more interesting.
